title: FeatureTable
description: Generated from packages/contracts/openapi.yaml by scripts/build_seed.py. Do not edit.

TerrainPackage.description: The single object every capture adapter must produce.

site_id.description: Set for curated sites; null for user scans.

antecedent_wetness.description: Mean root-zone soil wetness over the prior days (0–1 fraction, NASA POWER). TODO(verify) parameter.

synthetic.description: True when daily totals were spread over hours with an assumed profile.

rank.description: Rank among distinct storms by 1–3 day total, 1981 to present.

season_window.description: Day-of-year window; `terminate_doy < plant_doy` means it overwinters.

succession.description: v1.2. Vegetables may be sown in succession inside the window.

cover_curve.description: `[days_after_planting, cover_fraction]` points, ascending by day; fraction 0–1.

monthly_cover.description: One row per rotation year; each row has 12 monthly cover fractions (Jan–Dec, 0–1).

terrain_id.description: Used for the location's season-window check.

base_rotation_id.description: Preset the user edited, if any.

year.description: Rotation year the warning applies to.

rotation.description:
Present when `valid`. The edited rotation with a stable content-hash ID
(`rot_custom_…`) and computed cover calendar, usable in `SimulationRequest.rotation_ids`.

frames.description: URL path to the FTW1 frame file.

risk.description: URL path to the risk PNG.

frame_times_min.description: Time of each frame, minutes from storm start. Length = frame_count.

results.description: Keyed by rotation ID. Only rotations that are fully done appear; empty until then.

Metrics.description: Per rotation, per storm. Relative comparisons, not predictions.

max_abs_diff_mm.description: Scale used to encode the diff PNG.

mean_diff_mm.description: Mean of `b − a` over unmasked cells.

at_time_min.description: Minutes from storm start for timed insights; null otherwise.

evidence_items.description: Structured evidence with value, unit, basis and source (v1.1). `evidence` keeps the plain-text lines.

support_not_replace.const: This tool supports, and does not replace, local agronomic expertise.

images.description:
0–6 photos (JPEG, PNG, WEBP), sent as repeated `images` parts. Optional: with none,
the back-end uses an open-imagery fallback texture.

bbox.description: Optional `minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat` (comma-separated WGS84). Default is a server-chosen square around `lat`/`lon`.

value_range.description:
Physical `[min, max]`. For continuous layers, `value = min + byte / 254 * (max − min)`
for bytes 0–254. For categorical layers, the class index range.

url.description: URL path to the layer PNG.

examples: Soil hydrologic group B assumed everywhere.

cached.description: True when served from the on-disk cache after an upstream failure.

parent_id.description: Set for replies in a thread.

Scenario.description: Preset that reweights observed years. Modeled scenario, not a forecast. Preset values are echoed in `ScenarioApplied`.

ScenarioInput.description: Preset plus optional custom values. Custom values override the preset. Allowed ranges are server config (assumed); outside them the API returns `SCENARIO_OUT_OF_RANGE`.

rain_scale_pct.description: Percent change applied to every daily rain value, e.g. -20.

temp_offset_c.description: Degrees Celsius added to every daily temperature.

SeasonalRainScale.description: Percent rain change per meteorological season (winter = Dec–Feb in the northern hemisphere, Jun–Aug in the southern). Overrides `rain_scale_pct` for that season.

ramp.description: v1.2. Present on forecast responses. Slider values are reached at the end of the ramp.

WeekValues.description: One value per week, index 0–51 (7-day blocks from 1 January; days 358–366 fold into index 51). `null` = missing.

by_year.description: Year (e.g. `"1991"`) to 52 weekly values. Probability features (`*_prob`) hold 0/1 event flags per year.

interpolated.description: True when a coarser series was linearly interpolated to weekly.

FeatureThresholds.description: Every threshold is assumed (stated so reviewers can change it) except `extreme_rain_mm` and `wet_ground_value`, which are derived from the site's own baseline history.

sources_agree.description: POWER wetness vs SMAP anomaly signs match in at least the stated share of weeks; null when no SMAP seed.

limited_data.description: True when no seeded satellite or soil data is available.

features.description: Feature id to series. Ids: rain_mm, rain_max_day_mm, tmean_c, tmax_c, tmin_c, soil_wetness_root, soil_wetness_top, soil_moisture_anomaly, et0_mm, water_balance_mm, frost_prob, heat_prob, extreme_rain_prob, dry_spell_prob; plus ndvi, ndvi_anomaly, smap_anomaly where seeded.

j_wet.description: 0–1, share of years with heavy rain on wet ground in that week.

j_dry.description: 0–1, share of years in a dry spell in that week.

n_dry_days.description: Consecutive dry days that make a dry spell (assumed).

q_dry.description: A day below this rain (mm) counts as dry (assumed).

examples: Derived from terrain and soil data, not field-measured.

resolution_note.description: Set when the layer is coarser than the field (v1.2). One farm-level zone, not fake sub-pixels.

criteria_selected.description: Empty or missing means all seven.

weights.description: Criterion to weight (>= 0). Normalized to sum 1; all zero gives `INVALID_WEIGHTS`.

score.description: Relative index across the three rotations; higher is better.

range.description: Only on climate-driven criteria (water use, erosion risk).

year10_value.description: v1.2. Year-10 value of the underlying metric, same unit and basis as this row.

mean_value.description: v1.2. Mean of years 1–10 of the underlying metric, same unit and basis as this row.

rotations.description: Existing rotation first. Fewer than three only with a `NO_FEASIBLE_ALTERNATIVES` warning.

disclaimer.const: This tool supports, and does not replace, local agronomic expertise.

allOf.description: Trait fields (v1.1). All are typical crop traits, not measured on a field.

Ramp.description: Slider and preset values are phased in from year 0. Only linear is specified (PRD §5.7). Basis is assumed.

Number.description: Every reported quantity. Absolute estimates also set p10, p50 and p90.

AbsoluteYearSeries.description: Year series whose every point has a p10/p90 range (yield, forage, fertilizer, soil loss, and other ranged counts).

Trend.description: Observed Theil-Sen slope with a Mann-Kendall p-value. Reported as context, not extrapolated (PRD §5.3).

slope.description: Unit is on the number. Temperature trends use degC/year.

significant.description: True when mk_p_value is below the stated significance_alpha.

significance_alpha.description: Threshold for significant. Basis assumed until a source is cited.

days.description: Days per year above the crop heat limit, years 1–10, central and p10/p90.

FrostDate.description: Day of year, 1 = 1 January. Median is value and p50; p10 and p90 are the baseline spread.

scenario_shift_days.description: Days. Positive means later than the baseline.

extreme_rain_days.description: Count of days at or above the wet-day p95.

WaterBalanceOutlook.description: Surplus is positive, deficit is negative, millimetres. weekly_mm is the baseline climatology. Seasonal totals compare baseline and scenario.

ForecastHazard.description: Hazard names in group 2. Distinct from the v1.1 probability ids on VulnerableSeason.

growth_stage.description: Known stage ids from crop kc_stages are ini, mid, end. Unknown strings are rendered neutrally.

source.description: Planting records (rotation_plan) are primary. ndvi is a cross-check.

scene_count.description: Cloud-free scenes used, when source is ndvi.

StrategyEstimates.description: Absolute scenario estimates (decision D1). income_estimate is null when prices were not entered.

income_estimate.description: Null, plus a review flag, when the farmer entered no prices. Currency is the unit.

Trajectories.description:
Group 3. n_balance is the relative index (year 0 = 100). n_balance_kg_ha and n_fixed_share
are the companion figures named in group 3 that do not fit in one series.

market_fit.description: Null when no selected crop has a farmer rating. Unrated crops are review flags.

StrategyCore.description: Fields shared by a field strategy and the area-weighted farm rollup.

plan.description: Expanded horizon. Index 0 of the parent strategies array is the existing rotation.

strategies.description: Area-weighted totals keyed by strategy id (rot_existing, rot_alt_1, ...).

record_years.description: Record span as text, for example 1991-2024 or 2015+.

bias.description: POWER minus the local station. Unit is on the number.

request_hash.description: Full sha256 hex from app/twin/types.py request_hash.

support_sentence.const: This tool supports, and does not replace, local agronomic expertise.

assumptions.description: Unreviewed constants and ramp choices, one plain sentence each.

per_strategy.description: Strategy id to Year-10 metrics. Each metric is a Number.

TraitClass.description: low, medium, high. Same words as residue_class. Class boundaries are TODO(verify) with an agronomist.

NFixClass.description: none means the crop is not treated as fixing nitrogen. Scale is TODO(verify).

NullableTraitClass.description: Null means the class is not verified. Do not replace null with a default.

NullableNFixClass.description: Null means the fixation class is not verified.

NullableForageUse.description: Null means forage use is not verified.

EquipmentId.description: Catalog equipment id. The published set is CropCatalog.equipment. Pattern only, so W5 can add a sourced id without a contract bump.

NullableNumber.description: A measured or assumed number, or null when it is not verified. Do not replace null with a default.

ReferenceYield.description: Catalog reference yield. Null when no source has been recorded.

CropTraitV2.description: Trait schema v2. Extends CropTrait. Null numerics are unverified.

root_depth_m.description: Metres by stage. Null means not verified.

region_fit.description: Climate class strings. Empty means not verified. `oceanic` is the class named for UBC Farm.

unit.description: Farmer-entered unit, for example per tonne.

ForecastRequest.description:
climate_source defaults to history_resample until a future-climate dataset is verified
(decision D2). strategy_count defaults to 3. horizon_years defaults to 10.
Prices are never filled in by the server.

ErrorCode.description:
HTTP status mapping: INVALID_INPUT 422, UNSUPPORTED_FILE 415, FILE_TOO_LARGE 413,
TERRAIN_COVERAGE_MISSING 422, DATA_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE 503, WEATHER_UNAVAILABLE 503,
SIMULATION_TIMEOUT 504, NOT_FOUND 404, INTERNAL 500,
SITE_NOT_FOUND 404, UNKNOWN_CROP 422, INVALID_WEIGHTS 422, NO_FEASIBLE_ALTERNATIVES 422,
SCENARIO_OUT_OF_RANGE 422 (v1.1),
SELECTION_TOO_SMALL 422, INVALID_QUOTA 422, HORIZON_OUT_OF_RANGE 422 (v1.2).
